projectDescription: A Fabric mod that replaces Minecraft Java Edition's OpenGL renderer with a full Vulkan-based rendering engine for improved performance and modern GPU capabilities.
keyFeatures: Full Vulkan 1.2 renderer replacing Minecraft's OpenGL 3.2 renderer
Multiple chunk culling algorithms (frustum, graph-based section culling)
Indirect draw mode to reduce CPU overhead
GPU selector to pick the preferred rendering device
VMA (Vulkan Memory Allocator) based memory management
GLSL shaders compiled to SPIR-V via shaderc
publicApiSurface: net.vulkanmod.Initializer - Fabric mod entry point, exposes CONFIG and VERSION
net.vulkanmod.vulkan.Vulkan - Core Vulkan context: initVulkan(), cleanUp(), waitIdle()
net.vulkanmod.vulkan.Renderer - Main render loop: initRenderer(), getInstance(), getDrawer()
net.vulkanmod.config.Config - Mod configuration: advCulling, indirectDraw, frameQueueSize, device, entityCulling
net.vulkanmod.config.Platform - Platform detection: isWayLand(), isX11(), isWindows(), isMacOS()
net.vulkanmod.vulkan.device.DeviceManager - GPU device management: availableDevices, suitableDevices, init()
